'''Chems-Eddine Chitour''' ({{langx|ar|شمس الدين شيتور}}; 13 October 1944 – 19 April 2026) was an Algerian scholar, researcher, author and politician.

== Life and career ==
Chitour graduated from the National Polytechnic School and the Algerian Institute of petroleum in Algiers,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://perso.enp.edu.dz/~chitour/|title=Pr. C.E. CHITOUR|last=|first=|date=24 January 2020|website=|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131231080412/http://perso.enp.edu.dz:80/~chitour/ |archive-date=31 December 2013 |access-date=}}</ref> in the field of Chemistry. He did his doctorate "Es Sciences" at the Université Jean Monnet in France. He is the founder of valorization of [[fossil energy]] research laboratory. He worked as a professor and assisting professor at "IGC" and then ENSIACET{{Clarify|date=January 2022}} in the city of [[Toulouse]] in France. He published several scholarly articles and books.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/2043490826_Chems_Eddine_Chitour|title=Chems Eddine Chitour's research works {{!}} Algiers University, Algiers and other places|website=ResearchGate|language=en|access-date=2020-01-05}}</ref>

He took office on 4 January 2020 as Minister of Higher Education and Scientific Research.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.aps.dz/algerie/99731-m-chitour-chems-eddine-prend-ses-fonctions-a-la-tete-du-ministere-de-l-enseignement-superieur-et-de-la-recherche-scientifique|title=Chitour Chems-Eddine prend ses fonctions à la tête du ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur et de la recherche scientifique|first=Badra|last=Hafiane|website=www.aps.dz}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mesrs.dz/en/activite/-/asset_publisher/ylWq1hBeIHRB/content/--9-21?inheritRedirect=false&redirect=http://www.mesrs.dz:8080/activite?p_p_id=101_INSTANCE_ylWq1hBeIHRB&p_p_lifecycle=0&p_p_state=normal&p_p_mode=view&p_p_col_id=column-1&p_p_col_pos=2&p_p_col_count=3|title=Pr. Chems-Eddine Chitour takes office as Minister of Higher Education and Scientific Research - Activities : Ministère de l'enseignement supérieur et de la recherche scientifique|website=www.mesrs.dz|access-date=2020-01-05}}</ref>

Chitour died on 19 April 2026, at the age of 81.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-04-19 |title=Décès du sénateur et ancien ministre Chems Eddine Chitour |url=https://www.ennaharonline.com/fr/deces-du-senateur-et-ancien-ministre-chems-eddine-chitour/ |access-date=2026-04-19 |website=Ennahar Online |language=fr}}</ref>
